text:
Maya R: quick check — we're splitting Console roles for the new Analytics team. They need read access to dashboards + ability to run ad-hoc queries against production datasets. What's the least-privilege set we should grant? wondering org vs project scope.

Leo C: project-level is fine unless they need to create billing/export or link org policies. give BigQuery read + dashboard viewer only. avoid `roles/viewer` at org.

Sasha: +1 project-level. possible role combo: `roles/bigquery.dataViewer` + `roles/bigquery.jobUser` (if they run queries) + `roles/console.viewer` (dashboards). keep `roles/owner`/`editor` off.

Maya R: thanks — do we need `jobUser` for read-only queries? some dashboards run scheduled queries.

Jordan: scheduled queries usually run as a service account. if users only run ad-hoc, `dataViewer` is enough; `jobUser` allows them to run jobs that bill the project. check billing surface.

Samir: another note — logging/audit access: analytics folks want clickstream logs. instead of broad logging roles, create a custom role limited to `logging.logEntries.list` + `logging.logs.get` on the dataset export bucket. avoids `roles/logging.admin`.

Maya R: good point. is there a quick example of a custom role we can use?

Samir: example (super tiny):
```yaml
title: AnalyticsLogReader
permissions:
  - logging.logEntries.list
  - logging.logs.get
  - storage.objects.get
```
attach to project scope.

Leo C: also add note: redact PII before logs land in analytics workspace. ops can add a logging sink with a transform rule.

Maya R: any redaction snippet you can point to? want to include in the PR.

Jordan: example snippet we use in infra (not exact prod):
```yaml
transform:
  remove_fields:
    - user.email
    - user.ip
    - request.headers.authorization
```
This runs in the logging sink pipeline.

Sasha: workflow: 1) create custom log-reader role, 2) attach `bigquery.dataViewer` + optional `bigquery.jobUser`, 3) scope to project, 4) create logging sink with transform. file a console access request for each principal.

Maya R: sounds good. I'll draft the IAM PR with role definitions + redaction rule and post here. Thanks! :thumbsup:

infra-bot: FYI — created access request template: https://internal.company/access-requests. Use tag `analytics-console` to auto-route approvals.

Maya R: great — I'll use that. tagging @Sasha +@Samir for review on the PR once ready.

Sasha: happy to review.

Samir: can review infra bits.

Leo C: ping me if you need a quick permission sanity check before merge.

Maya R: will do — thanks everyone.
